title: Record the merged training steps and close their issues
summary: Pull requests #45, #46, #44, #42 and #43 merged to main. Reward version 2, the stock-PPO throughput profiler with its published profiles at 1, 32 and 128 robots, and the CPU AMP learner with the Table III networks are on main, and the launcher runs without the reservation guard. Issues #35 and #36 are closed; issue #37 keeps its pilot task. The registry records three new facts, updates the policy and simulation nodes and the Stage 2 blocker, and points the next question at the Step 5 pilot budget.
next: Freeze the Step 5 pilot budget and decision rule under issue #37.
